svg.text: Team 300024 · FIRST LEGO League · BIOGLOW Future Edition
ROBOT DESIGN — built it, changed it, scored it
Five missions, one Level Up, two minutes
thirty. Draw the order you run them in
and say why that order. The sequence is
the argument — the robot is only how you
Our table, set up for a full run
1. Nearest first — cross the table once
2. Heavy load last — the arm hides a sensor
3. Token — park once, or cycle it?
The base that won the argument
Label it: hub, two double motors, two
single motors, two colour sensors, wheel
size. Rule 5 allows no more, and there
is no gyro — it counts wheel turns and
At the mission model it was built for
what changed, and why — the Dino Diggers table
The base wandered on long runs
Shorter runs between walls; square up
on a wall, not on a guess
Added meshers so the tool registers
One mounting point, same two pins
Count rotations, not time — and charge
fill these in from real runs — never estimate
A judge believes 11 of 15. Nobody believes “almost always”.
watches the clock and the plan
All four work at the same time. Write
each name in — a judge asks, and “we all
did everything” is the wrong answer.
Every one of us built part of this
Two honest sentences about what is still
wrong with the robot. Judges trust a
team that can name its own weakest point
far more than one that says everything
Write it here, in pencil first
48 x 36 in tri-fold — wings 12 in, centre 24 in. Print at 100%; every box is a real size.
